name: EPA air pollution control technology fact sheet — SNCR
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. SNCR reduces NOx 30-50% alone and 65-75% with combustion controls; 870-1,150 C reaction window; 2-10 ppm ammonia slip; applicable 50-6,000 MMBtu/hr units; capital cost 900-2,500 USD per MMBtu/hr in 1999 dollars (year stated, not escalated). Evidence: https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P100RQ6Y.TXT
